title: Avoid remote attachment checks during FactBox refresh
summary: Attachment FactBox navigation performance improved by deferring external file existence checks until explicitly requested via export or preview, preventing repeated synchronous SharePoint calls during list browsing.
key_points: External-only attachments now rely on persisted metadata for HasContent() checks instead of making synchronous FileExists calls
Removed automatic external provider calls from FactBox refreshes and metadata validation scenarios
Export and preview operations now fail explicitly when external files are missing or account mappings are unconfigured
Expense Agent content-hash updates made best-effort to avoid blocking writes on transient retrieval failures
Added comprehensive test coverage for configured/unconfigured external storage, internal attachments, and retrieval failure scenarios
quote: Treat a coherent external-only attachment state as available content based on persisted metadata, matching the metadata-only behavior used for internally stored attachments.
